title: Understanding DFV Systems and Pathways
description: This module provides an overview of the domestic and family violence service system, including key pathways, service types, and coordination points. It helps learners understand how people access support, how services interact, and how systems work together to promote safety.
outcomes: Understand the structure and components of the DFV service system
Recognise key pathways for victim-survivors, children, and people using violence
Identify how services coordinate and interact to support safety
